title: NZ MBIE Determination 2025/027 (comparative): amendment, wall cladding terminating in channel drains
jurisdiction: New Zealand (Building Act 2004); Auckland Council; comparative only, not Alberta
code_edition: NZ Building Code (Schedule 1, Building Regulations 1992) as cited; E2/AS1 third edition, amendment 11, as cited; B2/AS1 referenced
source_url_note: Building CodeHub resource page for the same MBIE determination (Information provider: MBIE); the building.govt.nz determination page is WAF-blocked for this worker.

facts.text: The determination concerns an authority's refusal of an amendment to building consent proposing wall cladding that terminates within channel drains at the base of external walls.
The question is whether the plans and specifications gave sufficient evidence of compliance with B2 Durability and E2 External moisture.
The project is described as construction of 19 housing blocks across the site.
Figure 2 is a site diagram showing the locations of the proposed channel drains.
Figures 3 and 4 show channel-drain details beside brick veneer and weatherboard cladding.
Acceptable Solution E2/AS1 is cited at third edition, amendment 11.
